title: Dark Souls III
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. A failure report on an M4 Pro (highball-db#204, 2026-09-24) is open.
notes: works offline; anti-cheat softban risk online. Direct3D 11. On an M4 Pro DXMT froze the game on every kill and hung macOS's window server; D3DMetal (Apple's DirectX 12 support in the app) plays through kills there, confirmed 2026-09-25 by the reporter, so it is the mode the page recommends.

knownIssues.symptom: The game freezes when an enemy is killed, then crashes (reported on an M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXMT, Highball 0.9.35, highball-db#204, rated 2, launches but not playable).
knownIssues.cause: not in the game's log, which ends normally. The file the reporter attached is a WindowServer watchdog stackshot: macOS's window server stopped answering while the game ran (display state OFF at capture), which is the GPU or its driver hanging on the M4 Pro, not a fault inside Wine. Every kill triggers it for the reporter. Not reproduced on the M1 Pro here.
knownIssues.fix: use D3DMetal for this game (Apple's DirectX 12 support in the app). Confirmed by the reporter on the M4 Pro: kills no longer freeze it.

d3dmetal.detail: On an M4 Pro (macOS 26.6.2, engine r7) kills no longer freeze the game, confirmed by the reporter of highball-db#204 (shown as Apple's DirectX 12 support in the app).

dxmt.detail: On an M4 Pro every kill froze the game and then took the WindowServer down with it (a watchdog stackshot, highball-db#204). Community reports on other chips say DXMT works; the freeze is tied to the M4 Pro's GPU driver.
